Ligne de transport urbain de territoire de l'ouest. Données issus du GTFS SEMTO. Coverage: Territoire de la Côte Ouest, La Réunion. The portal shows 26,574 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2025-10-08 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-tco-re-portal.
